verses.text: A king's heart is in the LORD's hand like channels of water. He turns it wherever he wants.
Everyone thinks their own way is right, but the LORD weighs the heart.
Doing what's right and just pleases the LORD more than offering a sacrifice.
Arrogant eyes and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, are sin.
Careful plans and hard work lead to profit. Rushing into things leads straight to poverty.
Wealth gained by lies is a mist that vanishes, the pursuit of people headed for death.
The violence of the wicked sweeps them away because they refuse to do what's right.
The guilty take crooked paths. The innocent act uprightly.
It's better to live in a corner of the roof than share a house with a wife who's always picking fights.
The wicked crave evil. Their neighbor gets no mercy from them.
When a mocker is punished, the inexperienced grow wise. Teach a wise person and they'll gain knowledge.
The Righteous One takes notice of the house of the wicked and brings them to ruin.
Shut your ears to the cries of the poor and someday you'll cry out and nobody will hear you.
A gift given in secret calms anger. A bribe slipped under a cloak can quiet even fierce rage.
Doing justice brings joy to people who do right. It brings ruin to people who do evil.
Anyone who wanders away from the path of understanding will rest among the spirits of the dead.
Anyone who lives for pleasure will end up poor. Lovers of wine and oil won't get rich.
The wicked become a ransom for people who do right, and the treacherous for the upright.
It's better to live out in the desert than with a wife who argues and stays irritated.
Wise people keep precious treasure and oil in their homes. A fool uses it all up.
Chase righteousness and kindness and you'll find life, righteousness, and honor.
A wise person can climb the walls of a strong city and bring down the defenses it trusts in.
Watch what you say and you'll keep yourself out of trouble.
Call the proud and arrogant person “Mocker.” Pride drives everything they do.
A slacker's own cravings kill them, because their hands refuse to work.
Some people want more for themselves all day long. People who do right give freely and hold nothing back.
A sacrifice from the wicked is detestable, especially when they bring it with evil intent.
A false witness will perish. Someone who listens speaks words that last.
The wicked put on a bold face. The upright make sure their path is firm.
No wisdom, understanding, or advice can stand against the LORD.
You can get the horse ready for battle, but victory comes from the LORD.
